{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check cleaned revenue
print(f'First few cleaned revenue values: {sales["revenue_clean"].head().tolist()}')

# Confirm no QA orders remain
print(f'Any QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)? {sales[sales["revenue_clean"] == 999999.99].shape[0]}')"}
